title: Capacity Wizard visuals and microcopy library for Dedicated onboarding
creator: Lina Park
description: Design and produce a focused set of onboarding visuals and a microcopy library to support the Dedicated Capacity quickstart wizard. Deliverables include: a) step-by-step hero illustrations for the wizard (desktop + tablet + mobile), b) edge-case and error-state screens for quota/limit and capacity conflicts, c) an inline explainer for Autoscale knobs and SLA tier picker, d) a searchable microcopy file with localized strings placeholders, and e) exported assets and redlines for engineering handoff. The goal is to reduce first-time setup support tickets by clarifying trade-offs (cost vs. latency) and surfacing defaults that map to common customer personas (PLG < 100k tokens/day, Mid-market steady throughput, Enterprise SLA-backed pools).
acceptance_criteria: Hi-fi mockups for all wizard steps (Create Pool, Configure Autoscale, Set SLA Tier, Review & Launch) approved by PM and Eng
Edge-case screens (quota conflict, incompatible model selection, private deployment warnings) designed and annotated
Microcopy library contains final strings for inline help, tooltips, button labels, error messages, and analytics consent text
All assets exported in SVG/PNG and uploaded to Drive; Figma file contains named components and token mapping
Accessibility checks passed for color contrast and screen-reader labels; i18n placeholders verified
Engineering has an assets checklist and PR template with screenshot masks for sensitive data
